entry.en: Malaysia requires your passport to be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and to be undamaged with no missing pages.
entry.es: Malasia exige que tu pasaporte sea válido al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y esté sin daños ni páginas faltantes.
entry.quote: at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Make sure it is undamaged, with no pages missing.

entry.en: You must submit an arrival card online before travelling to enter Malaysia.
entry.es: Debes presentar una tarjeta de llegada en línea antes de viajar para entrar a Malasia.
entry.quote: You must submit an arrival card online to enter Malaysia. Do this before you travel

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: You must declare cash in any currency or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more when entering or exiting Malaysia.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo en cualquier moneda o cheques de viajero por 10.000 dólares o más al entrar o salir de Malasia.
entry.quote: you must declare cash in any currency or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more.

entry.en: Travelling between Peninsular and East Malaysia requires carrying your passport and getting entry and exit stamps.
entry.es: Para viajar entre Malasia peninsular y Malasia oriental debes llevar el pasaporte y obtener sellos de entrada y salida.
entry.quote: you must carry your passport. You will pass through immigration control and must get entry and exit stamps.

entry.en: Malaysian authorities could ask you to take a urine test on arrival if they suspect drug use.
entry.es: Las autoridades malasias podrían pedirte una prueba de orina a la llegada si sospechan consumo de drogas.
entry.quote: The Malaysian authorities could ask you to take a urine test on arrival if they suspect drug use.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to islands and dive sites off eastern Sabah from Sandakan to Tawau because of the threat of kidnapping.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja los viajes no esenciales a las islas y sitios de buceo de la costa oriental de Sabah, de Sandakan a Tawau, por la amenaza de secuestro.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to all islands and dive sites off the coast of eastern Sabah from Sandakan to Tawau, including Lankayan Island, due to the threat of kidnapping.

safety.en: Bag-snatching is common, particularly in major cities, and thieves on motorbikes can target tourists.
safety.es: El robo de bolsos es común, sobre todo en las grandes ciudades, y ladrones en moto pueden atacar a turistas.
safety.quote: Bag-snatching is common, particularly in major cities. Thieves on motorbikes can target tourists.

safety.en: There have been cases of strangers offering tourists spiked drinks, even in reputable bars or restaurants, and then robbing or assaulting them.
safety.es: Ha habido casos de desconocidos que ofrecen a turistas bebidas adulteradas, incluso en bares o restaurantes reputados, y luego los roban o agreden.
safety.quote: There have been cases of strangers offering tourists a spiked drink, even in reputable bars or restaurants, and then robbing or assaulting them.

safety.en: Malaysian authorities have a zero-tolerance policy on drug offences.
safety.es: Las autoridades malasias aplican tolerancia cero a los delitos de drogas.
safety.quote: The Malaysian authorities have a zero-tolerance policy to drug offences.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Malaysia under federal law.
safety.es: Los actos sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Malasia según la ley federal.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual acts are illegal in Malaysia under federal law.

safety.en: It is illegal under Malaysian law for foreign nationals to take part in demonstrations or protests.
safety.es: Según la ley malasia, es ilegal que extranjeros participen en manifestaciones o protestas.
safety.quote: It’s illegal under Malaysian law for foreign nationals to take part in demonstrations or protests.

health.en: Peninsular Malaysia is largely malaria-free, but there is a significant risk in Borneo, especially inland and in rural areas.
health.es: La Malasia peninsular está en gran parte libre de malaria, pero hay un riesgo significativo en Borneo, sobre todo en zonas del interior y rurales.
health.quote: Peninsular Malaysia is largely malaria-free, but there is a significant risk in Borneo especially in inland and rural areas.

health.en: Dengue fever occurs throughout Malaysia in urban and rural areas and can be avoided only by preventing mosquito bites.
health.es: El dengue se presenta en toda Malasia, en zonas urbanas y rurales, y solo se evita previniendo las picaduras de mosquitos.
health.quote: Dengue fever occurs throughout Malaysia in both urban and rural areas, and can be avoided only by preventing mosquito bites.

health.en: Opinions differ on whether tap water is safe to drink; it is treated and monitored, but the condition of the pipes is not always reliable.
health.es: Hay opiniones distintas sobre si el agua del grifo es segura; está tratada y vigilada, pero el estado de las tuberías no siempre es fiable.
health.quote: There are differences of opinion about whether and to what degree tap water is safe to drink. It is treated and monitored, but the condition of the pipes is not always reliable.

health.en: Government and private hospitals charge for all services, and private care is expensive.
health.es: Los hospitales públicos y privados cobran todos los servicios, y la atención privada es cara.
health.quote: Government and private hospitals charge for all services. Private care is expensive.

health.en: Forest fires in Indonesia can cause haze between June and October.
health.es: Los incendios forestales en Indonesia pueden causar bruma entre junio y octubre.
health.quote: Forest fires in Indonesia can cause haze between June and October.

health.en: Rabies is listed as a health risk in the states of Perlis, Kedah, Penang and Sarawak.
health.es: La rabia figura como riesgo sanitario en los estados de Perlis, Kedah, Penang y Sarawak.
health.quote: rabies in the states of Perlis, Kedah, Penang and Sarawak

help.en: Emergency numbers in Malaysia are 999 for police and ambulance, 994 for fire, and 112 for an ambulance from a mobile.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Malasia son 999 para policía y ambulancia, 994 para bomberos y 112 para ambulancia desde un móvil.
help.quote:
Police and ambulance: 999

Fire: 994

Ambulance (from a mobile): 112

getting_in.en: Most international flights land at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA).
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los vuelos internacionales aterrizan en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Kuala Lumpur (KLIA).
getting_in.quote: Most international flights land at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) (KUL IATA).

getting_in.en: Kota Kinabalu, Penang, Kuching, Langkawi and Johor Bahru have significant numbers of flights to regional destinations.
getting_in.es: Kota Kinabalu, Penang, Kuching, Langkawi y Johor Bahru tienen un número significativo de vuelos a destinos regionales.
getting_in.quote: Other airports which have significant numbers of flights to regional destinations are Kota Kinabalu (Sabah), Penang, Kuching (Sarawak), Langkawi and Johor Bahru.

getting_in.en: From Singapore there are two land crossings: the Causeway (Johor Bahru to Woodlands) and the Second Link (Iskandar Puteri to Tuas).
getting_in.es: Desde Singapur hay dos cruces terrestres: la Calzada (Johor Bahru a Woodlands) y el Second Link (Iskandar Puteri a Tuas).
getting_in.quote: The two crossings are the Causeway which links Johor Bahru with Woodlands in Singapore, and the Malaysia-Singapore Second Link (Linkedua) which links Iskandar Puteri with Tuas in Singapore.

getting_in.en: Trains from Thailand end at the border at Padang Besar, where Thai and Malaysian immigration formalities are done in the station.
getting_in.es: Los trenes desde Tailandia terminan en la frontera de Padang Besar, donde los trámites migratorios tailandeses y malasios se hacen en la estación.
getting_in.quote: Trains from Thailand start and terminate at the border at Padang Besar where Thai and Malaysian immigration formalities are all conveniently done in the station

getting_in.en: Ferries connect Peninsular Malaysia with Sumatra and southern Thailand, Sarawak with Brunei, and Sabah with East Kalimantan and Mindanao.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris que conectan Malasia peninsular con Sumatra y el sur de Tailandia, Sarawak con Brunéi, y Sabah con Kalimantan Oriental y Mindanao.
getting_in.quote: Ferries connect various points in Peninsular Malaysia with Sumatra in Indonesia and southern Thailand, Sarawak with Brunei, and Sabah with East Kalimantan in Indonesia and Mindanao in the Philippines.

getting_in.en: There is no official crossing into Sabah from Indonesia even though they share a land border.
getting_in.es: No hay un cruce oficial hacia Sabah desde Indonesia aunque comparten frontera terrestre.
getting_in.quote: There is no official crossing into Sabah from Indonesia even though they share a land border.

getting_around.en: Flying is the only practical way to travel between Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo.
getting_around.es: Volar es la única opción práctica para viajar entre la Malasia peninsular y Borneo.
getting_around.quote: Flying is the only practical option for traveling between Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo, as well as reaching some of the more remote outposts of Borneo.

getting_around.en: The cheapest way to travel in Malaysia is by bus, and all towns of any size have a bus terminal.
getting_around.es: La forma más barata de viajar por Malasia es en autobús, y todas las ciudades de cierto tamaño tienen terminal.
getting_around.quote: The cheapest way to travel in Malaysia is by bus. All towns of any size have a bus terminal offering connections to other parts of the country.

getting_around.en: KTMB trains offer relatively inexpensive and generally reliable service around Peninsular Malaysia, but not in Sabah or Sarawak.
getting_around.es: Los trenes de KTMB ofrecen un servicio relativamente barato y generalmente fiable en la Malasia peninsular, pero no en Sabah ni Sarawak.
getting_around.quote: State operator Keretapi Tanah Melayu Berhad (KTMB) provides relatively inexpensive and generally reliable services around Peninsular Malaysia (but not Sabah/Sarawak in Borneo).

getting_around.en: Many taxis refuse to use the meter even though there is an official rate.
getting_around.es: Muchos taxis se niegan a usar el taxímetro aunque existe una tarifa oficial.
getting_around.quote: Many taxis will refuse to use the meter, even though there is an official rate. Most taxis now have a sticker on the rear door informing tourists that haggling is prohibited.

getting_around.en: Grab is the most popular ride-hailing app.
getting_around.es: Grab es la aplicación de transporte privado más popular.
getting_around.quote: The most popular ride hailing app is Grab, which took over

getting_around.en: Traffic in Malaysia drives on the left.
getting_around.es: En Malasia se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Traffic in Malaysia drives on the left, a legacy left by the British.

money.en: The currency is the Malaysian ringgit (RM, MYR), divided into 100 sen.
money.es: La moneda es el ringgit malayo (RM, MYR), dividido en 100 sen.
money.quote: The Malaysian currency is the Malaysian ringgit, abbreviated as RM (ISO code: MYR). It is divided into 100 sen (cents).

money.en: QR code mobile payments are increasingly common in Malaysia and more widely accepted than credit cards.
money.es: Los pagos móviles con código QR son cada vez más comunes en Malasia y más aceptados que las tarjetas de crédito.
money.quote: QR code-based mobile payments are increasingly common in Malaysia, and are more widely accepted than credit cards.

money.en: Many Malaysian ATMs do not allow withdrawals with foreign debit cards due to fraud risk, so try another ATM if yours is rejected.
money.es: Muchos cajeros malasios no permiten retirar con tarjetas de débito extranjeras por riesgo de fraude; si te la rechazan, prueba otro cajero.
money.quote: Due to fraud risk, many Malaysian ATMs do not allow you to withdraw using foreign debit cards. If your card is rejected, try another ATM.

money.en: Some ATMs offer to convert the currency for you, which is disadvantageous, so decline conversion to your home currency.
money.es: Algunos cajeros ofrecen convertir la moneda, lo cual es desventajoso, por lo que conviene rechazar la conversión a tu moneda.
money.quote: will offer to do the currency conversion for you, which is disadvantageous

money.en: Tipping is not customary in Malaysia, and most air-conditioned restaurants include a 10% service charge in the bill.
money.es: En Malasia no es costumbre dar propina, y la mayoría de los restaurantes con aire acondicionado incluyen un 10% de servicio en la cuenta.
money.quote: Tipping is not customary in Malaysia. A service charge of 10% is included in total bill in most air conditioned restaurants

money.en: Credit card and ATM fraud is widespread, so take care when using your card.
money.es: El fraude con tarjetas de crédito y cajeros es generalizado, así que ten cuidado al usar tu tarjeta.
money.quote: Credit card and ATM fraud is widespread. Take care when using your card.

etiquette.en: Always take off your shoes when entering a home or place of worship; this is often required at hostels too.
etiquette.es: Quítate siempre los zapatos al entrar en una casa o lugar de culto; a menudo también se exige en los hostales.
etiquette.quote: When entering a home or a place of worship, always take off your shoes (this is often required at hostels too).

etiquette.en: Never eat or give a gift with your left hand, and never point with your forefinger.
etiquette.es: Nunca comas ni des un regalo con la mano izquierda, y nunca señales con el dedo índice.
etiquette.quote: never eat with your left hand or give a gift with your left hand, and never point with your forefinger

etiquette.en: Women are not legally required to wear the hijab except when entering mosques, where it is required for Muslims and non-Muslims alike.
etiquette.es: Las mujeres no están obligadas legalmente a llevar hiyab salvo al entrar en mezquitas, donde se exige a musulmanes y no musulmanes.
etiquette.quote: Women are not legally required to wear the hijab, known locally as the tudung, except when entering mosques, where it is required for both Muslims and non-Muslims.

etiquette.en: Public displays of affection in larger, more diverse cities are tolerated but might attract unnecessary attention.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto en las ciudades grandes y diversas se toleran, pero pueden atraer atención innecesaria.
etiquette.quote: Public showing of affection in the more diverse, larger cities is tolerated but might invite unnecessary attention from the public.

etiquette.en: As a visitor, it is best not to criticise the government or the Malaysian royal families.
etiquette.es: Como visitante, es mejor no criticar al gobierno ni a las familias reales de Malasia.
etiquette.quote: As in many countries, it is best not to criticise the government or the Malaysian royal families as a visitor.

etiquette.en: When using chopsticks, do not stick them vertically into a bowl of rice.
etiquette.es: Al usar palillos, no los claves en vertical en un cuenco de arroz.
etiquette.quote: do not stick your chopsticks vertically into a bowl of rice.

connectivity.en: Free broadband internet is available in most accommodations and some restaurants.
connectivity.es: Hay internet de banda ancha gratis en la mayoría de los alojamientos y en algunos restaurantes.
connectivity.quote: Broadband Internet is available for free in most accommodations and some restaurants

connectivity.en: The easiest SIM to get is U-mobile, from RM10, with ok-ish coverage.
connectivity.es: La SIM más fácil de conseguir es U-mobile, desde RM10, con una cobertura aceptable.
connectivity.quote: The easiest SIM to get is U-mobile, from RM10, with ok-ish coverage

connectivity.en: SIMs are available in every 7-11 and in some other places.
connectivity.es: Las SIM se venden en todos los 7-11 y en otros lugares.
connectivity.quote: SIMs are available in every 7-11 and in some other places.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards sold at airports are pretty affordable.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM de prepago que se venden en los aeropuertos son bastante asequibles.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid SIM cards for sale at airports are pretty affordable
